body:
Part of **New page: Strategy** (72986e081ef982d9). Every page piece is Gleam compiled to JavaScript; server pieces are Rust (`tasks.rs`, `board.rs`). Nothing compiles to BEAM.

Replaces the separate archive page (see **Create Task Archive**, f3df2a07c44a8d64).

- It reads `GET /tasks` (root) plus `/events` replay and updates. Each row shows title, column, project (`home`), feature, milestone and `closedTime`. Selecting a row opens `<solace-task>` beside or below the list.
- **Sort and filter on the client.** Sort by `closedTime`, newest first, as the default. Filter by column, project, feature and milestone, which are now task fields (D-87). Text search covers title and body.
- **What client-side search misses.** `GET /tasks` leaves out `notes` and `changes`. Searching them needs a server search endpoint. Defer it to the mass-edit/archive task, or add `GET /tasks?q=` then.
- **Inline links.** Feature and milestone are edited inline through `PATCH /tasks/{id}`, which is allowed in final columns and during runs (D-87 point 4, D-88).
- **Workspace roots.** Tasks of every project come from the root's `/tasks` only if the root's list includes them. Check `GET /tasks` at a workspace root before building; otherwise merge the lists per project from `/projects`.

**Scope:** `solace-cli/strategy` is not in the root `solace.toml` yet. A human adds it, then it is added to this task's scope.
title: Strategy: Tasks tab
